# v0.2.0

- History, the guide and the version are now quiet links in the status bar; the window has no toolbar.
- Fixed the list settings of folders that only had an older list record.
- A crash during an apply can no longer leave a change that undo cannot reach.
- Deleting or renaming presets and dropping several folders now behave correctly; Esc closes History and the guide.
- External and network volumes are only read, and the permission prompts now say so.
